attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the DHCP server on the private eth1 network (10.50.50.0/24, pool .100-.200) shared with node2/node3. node2 and node3 already used systemd-networkd's wildcard DHCP=yes match for en*/eth* interfaces (no static config existed on their private NICs, ens7); after node1's DHCP server came up, both nodes obtained dynamic leases (node2: 10.50.50.100, node3: 10.50.50.101) confirmed via networkd restart and cross-pings. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, verifying changed boot_id and full recovery of DHCP service (node1) and DHCP-obtained addressing (node2, node3) after each restart, with primary default routes on 10.100.243.0/24 left undisturbed throughout.
